name: StreamFlix
overview: Netflix-style UI, server-verified Google Sign-In & Netflix profiles backed by real Jellyfin users
description: Transforms Jellyfin Web into StreamFlix: a Netflix-style cinema UI with an animated show/film mosaic gate, server-verified Google Sign-In (signed sessions), and Netflix 'Who's watching?' profiles mapped to real Jellyfin users with PIN and per-profile Google account locks.

versions.changelog: v0.5: initial public beta release — Netflix-style home screen with living billboard & hover previews, server-verified Google Sign-In with HMAC household sessions, real multi-user 'Who's watching?' profiles with PIN & Google account locks, custom video player with Episodes & Seasons drawer, unified Audio & Subtitles popover, Next Episode countdown & Auto-skip intros, Quick Connect & Cast in the profile menu, and tuned Desktop, Phone & 10-foot Smart TV layouts.
